nina (People Ops): @here Quick update: NYC MTA announced a 24-hour transit strike on Tue 2026-05-19. Were closing the NYC office for safety and commute disruption. Office closed Tue 5/19 (remote-first day).

nina (People Ops): For anyone who had candidate interviews, on-site meetings, or vendor visits that day: please move to virtual or reschedule. If you need People Ops help to rebook candidates, reply with names and times.

omar (Facilities): Building lobby will be open for badge pickup 08:30-10:00 for folks who need to retrieve personal items, but contractors will not be allowed entry. If you need to grab equipment, request an escorted slot by EOD Mon.

nina (People Ops): Transit stipend: $20 one-way for folks who must travel into the city for essential work (expense code nyc-strike-26). Keep receipts/screenshots.

jess: I have 4 candidates scheduled 9-12. Can we get a shared Zoom link and proctor room at the co-working fallback?

nina (People Ops): @jess We can provide a Zoom Pro link + book a small room at WeWork Bryant (2 desks reserved) if you need an in-person quiet space. DM me names and preferred time windows.

vendor-bot: Delivery update: UPS scheduled to attempt deliveries Tue morning. Facilities requests rescheduling to Wed or hold at hub.

omar (Facilities): If you expect a vendor or equipment delivery, please change the delivery address to our secure holding address (we'll DM details) or contact facilities by 18:00 Mon.

sarah: Im on-call Tue and may need to access rack keys. Any process?

omar (Facilities): @sarah On-call staff will be granted escorted after-hours access. Submit quick-access request here: https://forms.company/access by 12:00 Tue. We'll coordinate with security.

nina (People Ops): Coworking fallback: We have 10 desks at WeWork Bryant + 4 dayrooms for nursing parents/quiet work. First-come, reply with which window you want.

nina (People Ops): Headcount for shuttles: if you absolutely must come in from NJ/LI, we can run a single commuter shuttle 07:30 departure from Secaucus Transit Center -> HQ and return 18:30. Reply with yes/no and preferred pickup. Limited seats.

jess: Thanks, booking WeWork for my panel. Will DM candidate names.

nina (People Ops): Reminder for managers: if your team needs headcount approval for essential onsite staff, submit via the usual manager-approval thread and cc People Ops.

calendar-bot: Event created: "NYC Office - Remote Day (MTA Strike)" 2026-05-19. Location: Remote / WeWork fallback.

omar (Facilities): For folks who park in Lot B: gate will be locked Tue. Use street parking or plan to use shuttle.

nina (People Ops): We'll post one more reminder Mon evening with confirmed shuttle info and coworking passcodes. DM for any confidential accessibility needs. :handshake:
